checks.name: gate:g0_remains_teaching_only
checks.detail: {"allowed_claim": "Teaching-parameter two-dimensional IGZO simulation", "missing_primary_inputs": ["condition-complete raw Id-Vg", "condition-complete raw Id-Vd", "device batch identity", "measurement or simulation condition metadata"], "prohibited_claim": "Accurate experimental fit or calibrated dual-gate prediction", "quantitative_fitting_permitted": false, "required_primary_fields": ["dataset_id", "device_id", "sweep_id", "VGS_V", "VDS_V", "ID_A", "W_um", "L_um", "temperature_K", "sweep_direction", "source", "source_status"], "status": "TEACHING_BASELINE_ONLY", "t01_permitted": true}

checks.name: scope:igzo_2d_laptop_teaching_model_only
checks.detail: 2D n-IGZO electron-only drift-diffusion teaching model with the T02-A enabled symmetric dual-gate stack

checks.name: model:linearized_single_interface_limitations_are_explicit
checks.detail: The sheet charge is a quasi-static linearized response, not an energy-resolved occupancy model. Only the bottom interface receives D_it; the source paper used a different single-gate stack. No bulk tail/deep states, capture-emission time constants, hysteresis, bias stress, border traps, or temperature dependence are represented. All extracted quantities remain numerical proxies in an uncalibrated teaching model.

checks.name: controls:geometry_transport_contact_temperature_and_top_interface_frozen
checks.detail: L=10 um W=60 um tch=24 nm tox=30/30 nm mesh=interface_4x top_Dit=0

checks.name: extraction:vth_and_gm_methods_inherit_t02_c
checks.detail: {"constant_current_vth_proxy": {"criterion_formula": "10 nA * (W/L) terminal current", "criterion_prefactor_a": 1e-08, "expected_current_per_width_a_per_cm": 1e-05, "expected_terminal_current_a": 6e-08, "interpolation": "linear primary-gate-voltage interpolation in log10(abs(drain current per unit width))", "name": "constant_current_log_interpolation"}, "gm_proxy": {"definition": "central-difference derivative of abs(drain current) versus primary-gate voltage, linearly interpolated at VTH + 0.2 V", "evaluation_overdrive_v": 0.2, "name": "central_difference_then_linear_interpolation", "reported_units": ["S/cm", "S terminal"]}}

checks.name: extraction:ss_and_ioff_are_fixed_before_run
checks.detail: {"ioff": {"definition": "abs(drain current) at VTG=-0.5 V, VBG=0 V, and VDS=0.01 V", "evaluation_top_gate_v": -0.5, "name": "fixed_lowest_gate_voltage_current", "reported_units": ["A/cm", "A terminal"]}, "ss": {"endpoint_method": "log-current interpolation to exact fixed-window endpoints", "fit": "ordinary least squares of top-gate voltage versus log10(abs(drain current per unit width))", "lower_current_a_per_cm": 1e-07, "minimum_augmented_sample_count": 4, "name": "fixed_current_window_ols", "reported_unit": "mV/dec", "upper_current_a_per_cm": 1e-05}}

checks.name: hypotheses:directions_registered_but_not_completion_gate
checks.detail: A reproducible contrary trend is still a valid result; the linearized neutral-potential assumption can alter low-gate charge direction.

checks.name: acceptance:numerics_reproduction_extraction_and_response_are_frozen
checks.detail: convergence, conservation, T02-C reproduction, extractability, and nonzero response are mandatory

checks.name: boundary:formal_interface_scan_does_not_complete_p2_or_t03
checks.detail: After contract, simulation, and independent persisted-evidence checks pass, the three literature-constrained bottom-interface D_it inputs have completed a controlled transfer sensitivity in the frozen teaching model, with VTH, SS, Ioff, and gm reported only as numerical proxies.

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: After contract, simulation, and independent persisted-evidence checks pass, the three literature-constrained bottom-interface D_it inputs have completed a controlled transfer sensitivity in the frozen teaching model, with VTH, SS, Ioff, and gm reported only as numerical proxies.
prohibited_claims: measured or fitted project D_it, calibrated SS, physical Ion/Ioff, mobility, or process prediction
energy-resolved interface-state distribution, dynamic capture-emission, hysteresis, bias-stress, reliability, or border-trap validation
bulk N_tail or N_deep trap evidence or complete P2 trap group
both-interface trap validation or complete T03 five-group sensitivity
compact-model, circuit, layout, or HZO evidence
evidence_boundary.next_gate: Only a passed formal scan plus independent check completes the interface-D_it substage and permits a separate T03-P2-BULK-TRAPS contract; P3, P5, SPICE, and layout remain closed.
